subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about winning back your lapsed and cancelled viewers. A timely shift worth flagging: as the password-sharing crackdown that drove Netflix's 2024 subscriber surge plateaus and enforcement goes global through 2026, platforms are leaning back on win-back. The economics favor you: acquiring a fresh streaming subscriber runs up to 200 dollars and costs 5 to 7 times more than retaining one, so reactivating a former subscriber is the cheaper lane. We read those resubscribes against a holdout so they show as incremental. Worth comparing to your mix?
angle: fresh angle: password-crackdown plateau shifting platforms to win-back (sourced) + streaming acquire-vs-retain cost band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN subscription_media: acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior; fresh angle = timely development (Netflix crackdown surge plateauing, enforcement going global through 2026) + sourced streaming acquire-vs-retain band (up to $200 acquisition; 5-7x retain vs acquire, spyro-soft); only Netflix named (in brand_candidates), no brand outside list; MobUpps holdout reference carries no figure; market numbers web-verified with URLs; exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y'.
